summary.en: An ambush in eastern DR Congo struck forces linked to Erik Prince's security firm, killing an ex-New Zealand special forces officer and wounding former UFC fighter Tim Kennedy and a retired US Green Beret. The attack occurred amid intensified fighting around the M23 rebel campaign. An African Union panel is meeting President Tshisekedi in Kinshasa as part of shuttle diplomacy on the crisis. The UCDP recorded 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Et bakholdsangrep i østlige DR Kongo rammet styrker knyttet til Erik Princes sikkerhetsfirma, og drepte en tidligere New Zealand-spesialstyrkeoffiser og såret den tidligere UFC-utøveren Tim Kennedy samt en pensjonert amerikansk Green Beret. Angrepet skjedde mens kampene rundt M23‑opprørernes kampanje intensiverte. Et panel fra Den afrikanske unionen møter president Tshisekedi i Kinshasa som en del av shuttle-diplomati om krisen. UCDP registrerte 1 158 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: M23 campaign (2022–present)
background.extract: The M23 campaign is an ongoing series of military offensives launched by the March 23 Movement (M23), a Rwandan-backed rebel paramilitary group in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, since March 2022. In November 2021, M23 first launched attacks against the Congolese military (FARDC) and MONUSCO, seizing military positions in Ndiza, Cyanzu, and Runyoni in North Kivu Province. This coincided with the deployment of Uganda People's Defence Force (UPDF) to the region to combat the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), a Ugandan rebel group operating in the Congo's North Kivu and Ituri provinces.
